ns2:section.sectionText: *Reserved for students in the Media Sales Certificate program. Please contact the instructor, Dionne Clifton, at dclifton@illinois.edu for more information on registering for this course. Note: students should contact Professor Clifton AFTER a sales internship has been secured. Students must have secured their internship and have it approved no later than October 1 to receive permission to enroll. This section is for students completing a Fall sales internship.
